title: Leptogenesis from the model's intrinsic L-violation (F47) + 3-generation CP (F53/F75)

L1_L_violation.source: F47 Majorana step is anti-linear (chi <-> chi*)
L1_L_violation.status: DERIVED — intrinsic to the Higgs-free Majorana mass
L1_L_violation.note: F47 Majorana step anti-linear -> intrinsic lepton-number violation

L2_cp_available.note: F53: C maximal; 3-gen (F75) lepton sector has 1 Dirac + 2 Majorana phases

L3_out_of_eq_sphalerons.sphaleron_source: SU(2)_L gauge structure (F27/F34/F41) -> electroweak sphalerons (B+L violation)
L3_out_of_eq_sphalerons.note: feeble sterile coupling -> freeze-in; SU(2)_L -> sphalerons convert L to B

L4_magnitude_same_sector.requires: near-degenerate N_{2,3} (resonant CP enhancement) + O(1) CP phases
L4_magnitude_same_sector.note: baryon asymmetry (sphaleron freeze-out) + larger late lepton asymmetry both from N_{2,3}
L4_magnitude_same_sector._desc: baryon + lepton asymmetry from same N_{2,3}

L5_verdict.verdict: YES — the model's intrinsic lepton-number violation (F47, derived) plus 3-generation CP violation (F53/F75, available: 1 Dirac + 2 Majorana phases) plus feeble-coupling out-of-equilibrium dynamics meet ALL three Sakharov conditions, and the SU(2)_L sphalerons convert L to B. So the SAME sterile sector (the two heavy N_{2,3} of the F201 texture) can source BOTH the baryon asymmetry and the ~1e6x-larger late lepton asymmetry resonant keV-DM production needs (the nuMSM unification). Not derived: the CP-phase magnitudes and the N_{2,3} degeneracy that set the asymmetry's SIZE — the same free corner the nuMSM uses, inherited not solved.
